Turning advanced mode off puts every setting only it shows back to its default and saves the settings of this page. Turn it off?

Advanced mode shows every setting of the simulator and the starter, including ones that can stop the simulator from starting, make it unstable or spoil the picture. It also lets you change the crews of consists, AI consists and decorations, so a scenario may not play as its author meant.
Change these settings only if you know what they do. Trouble they cause is not a bug of the simulator: before reporting one, turn advanced mode off and restore the default settings.
Read this carefully. The button to turn it on works in 20 seconds.

On Linux you can also point to the Windows build (eu07.exe) — it runs through Wine or Proton.
